set.body:
Goal: derive expected records independently of the eyes4s parser.

Acceptance criteria:
- A separate reference extractor uses the vendor EDF Access API to enumerate supported samples, native events, messages, and recording metadata into canonical manifests.
- Where licensing permits, SR Research read_asc behavior or another independently maintained ASC reader produces a second ASC-level manifest.
- Oracle tools are version-pinned or identified by executable/source digest and cannot import eyes4s parser code.
- Canonical schema preserves raw/effective message times, eye, coordinate mode, pupil representation, optional fields, recording blocks, source ordering, and omissions caused by converter flags.
- Licensing restrictions are respected: private tools may generate committed/public oracle manifests without redistributing proprietary code.
- Regeneration instructions and source/converter/oracle hashes make stale manifests detectable.
- Deliberately changed converter options or swapped eye channels change the manifest and fail the oracle court.
set.title: Build independent EDF API and vendor ASC oracle manifests
